grammar-de-det-possessive-seinen.explanation: The v6 prompt explicitly says that Er ... seinen establishes gender[psor] Masc; the model instead left gender[psor] null while matching every other scored field.

grammar-de-det-formal-possessive-ihrem.explanation: The v6 prompt separates agreement number from possessor number, assigns fixed possessor number only to mein/dein/sein and unser/euer, and requires unsupported or unestablished values to remain null. This formal Ihr context does not establish whether the addressee is singular or plural, but the model invented number[psor] Sing.
